title: Probing: depth, margin, furcations and mobility
summary: Record the probing in the three passes, with the keypad, the previous exam as a guide or copying it.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart with probing is the guide (a screening never is).

steps.title: Exam type
steps.details: Initial, re-evaluation or maintenance need full probing. Screening and implants only have their own guide.

steps.title: Copy everything from the previous exam
steps.details: If the patient is stable, start from the previous exam's values and adjust what changed. What is copied stays underlined until confirmed.

steps.title: Depth and bleeding
steps.details: First pass: the depth of each site.

steps.title: What to record now
steps.details: It says the tooth and site of the next number. Type the digits: the probe moves on by itself to the next empty site.

steps.title: The chart
steps.details: The curves are drawn as you record. Tap a cell to go to that site; a BOP dot cycles bleeds → suppurates.

steps.title: Bleeding, suppuration and plaque
steps.details: They go to the site with the dashed ring: the last one measured or the one you tapped. Keyboard: B, S and P.

steps.title: Which arch is shown
steps.details: With “Follows the probe” the view goes with the probe; a notice shows when the arch changes.

steps.title: Gingival margin
steps.details: Second pass: positive is recession (the gum went down), negative enlargement. “No recession” records 0.

steps.title: Keypad
steps.details: Digits, delete, +1 for 10 mm or more, “Same as before” and the minus sign.

steps.title: Furcations and mobility
steps.details: Third pass, per tooth: mobility from 0 to III and the grade of each furcation. It does not block closing.

steps.title: Tooth status
steps.details: If the odontogram does not match the mouth, fix it here: missing teeth and pontics are not probed.

steps.title: Next: Progress
steps.details: With probing complete, the next step compares with earlier exams.
